value.proposal: Keep an Epithelial compartment defined by Pan_Cytokeratin, E_cadherin (compared on the membrane) and EpCAM (majority_epithelial), with Keratin_14 and TP63 as shared epithelial evidence; epithelial cells away from leukocytes (epithelial_away) become the known-negative reference of the leukocyte markers (CD8, CD4, CD20, CD79a, CD11c, CD56, CD66, MPO, CD31, Vimentin) and the check of SMA; T cells are a further reference for non-T markers (CD20, CD79a, CD11c, CD66, MPO). SOX2's role is left 'none' until reviewed.
value.rationale: The source method's leukocyte-marker references are endocrine/exocrine cells, which spleen lacks; epithelium is the remaining population that cannot carry leukocyte markers. The plan's further references 'CD3e on CD20+ cells' and 'CD68/CD163 on lymphocytes' have no population in levels.populations yet (only t_cells exists), so only T cells are added.
value.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); maintainer 2026-10-31: epithelium is present in spleen

value.affects: CD8;label T cell;label CD8 T cell
value.proposal: A CD8+ cell with CD31 and no CD3e is not a T cell: it is never named CD8 T cell. As written, the T lineage is named only with CD3e positive (named_by broad), so such a cell is tagged T_not_named and falls to the pan label (Hematopoietic CD45+/-); the proposal is to record it instead as a canary conflict or an endothelial-compartment cell.
value.rationale: Red-pulp sinusoidal lining (littoral) cells express CD8a and CD31 without CD3e; counting them as CD8 T cells would inflate red-pulp T cells.
value.topic: CD8+CD31+ littoral cells are not CD8 T cells

value.proposal: CD21 is shared hematopoietic evidence carried by B cells (adds depth, never names a cell); the manifest's CD21_positive_B_cell leaf stays descriptive and needs CD20 or CD79a; no FDC is named from CD21 alone.
value.rationale: Follicular dendritic cells carry CD21 without being B cells; CD21 alone cannot name either.
value.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); spleen manifest add_rules CD21_positive_B_cell
value.topic: CD21 is on FDCs and B cells

value.proposal: Iba1 is not on PC67 (CD45 holds its barcode, maintainer 2026-10-31). Macrophages follow the 10-27 owner rule instead of the sheet's Iba1 row: CD68+ or CD163+ (the broad Myeloid markers), CD3e and epithelial markers negative through the canary, labelled by the CD68/CD163 | M2Gal3/CD4 profile; CD206 and M2Gal3 add depth. CD45 is the pan-leukocyte marker, as in the source method. B3TUBB is absent, so Neural and Schwann are unavailable.
value.rationale: The selected sheet's Macrophage row needs Iba1, which PC67 does not acquire.
value.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); owner rule 2026-10-27

value.affects: CD31;CD34;Caveolin;Podoplanin;label Endothelium Blood Vessel;label Endothelium Lymphatic
value.proposal: Endothelial labels are structure rows (Blood vessel named by CD31, Lymphatic by Podoplanin); with no working spleen vessel or lymphatic object (SmallVessel calls 29-78 % of tissue on PC67, being retrained), no cell is named endothelial and CD31, CD34, Caveolin and Podoplanin add shared evidence only. Revisit after the vessel objects exist.
value.rationale: The 10-30 ruling allows endothelial cell types only through structure objects.
value.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); owner 2026-10-30 structure-only ruling

value.proposal: When spleen objects (regions, vessels) arrive, each object check records which channels built its object; a check on the object's own input marker is reported as non-independent, never as a pass. No check_objects entries are written now.
value.rationale: Regions and vessels come from classifiers reading the same channels; enrichment of a marker in an object built from that marker proves nothing.
value.topic: Object-enrichment checks must be independent of the object's own markers

value.proposal: levels.py's immune-core, immune2 and whole-cell positivity checks read leukocyte markers on hormone-positive endocrine cells (cell_sets/populations 'hormone'), and canary.py's epithelial null includes them. Spleen has none, so those rates are not evaluable and the immune core stops on every section. Proposal: the tissue hook supplies that check population (spleen: epithelial_away, P1) so the same checks run; this changes ported code and is not done.
value.rationale: Without it the spleen registry cannot pass the level selection: the method would stop rather than type.
value.topic: Immune checks need a spleen reference population (method change)

value.proposal: CD11c is a Myeloid:cDC subtype marker and CD209 shared myeloid evidence, but the Macrophage profile rule names every Myeloid cell by its CD68/CD163 profile and a CD11c-only cell (no CD68/CD163) is not named Myeloid. Proposal: decide whether cDC is its own lineage or a profile label.
value.rationale: The selected sheet has cDC under Myeloid; the method's profile rule has no subtype path for it.
value.source: spleen manifest (cDC, CD141_positive_cDC rows); raised while writing this registry

value.proposal: FOXP3 is a state flag on T cells (Treg = CD4 T cell with FOXP3 positive) rather than a T subtype competing with CD4/CD8 under the 'higher marker' rule.
value.rationale: The 'higher' subtype rule would let FOXP3 compete with CD4 although Tregs are CD4+.
value.source: spleen manifest (Treg row); raised while writing this registry
